source.title: Benchmark dataset for hydraulic simulations of flash floods in the French Mediterranean region

experiment: Simulated OSSE on event-based terrain and river geometry; simulated hydraulics and simulated change-SAR
state_transition: Each method propagates its own complete previous analysis through the same registered physical solver before the next acquisition.
red_boundary: ETKF post-analysis ensemble-mean depth >= 0.05 m and immediate ETKF pre-analysis ensemble-mean depth < 0.05 m
claim_boundary: Traditional ETKF visualization only; not real SAR, not a learned-method result, and not SOTA evidence.
